nodes.notes: Stops a second email in the same thread from resending the form.

parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Every minute: new inbox mail (never our own) is read by the AI. A supplier inquiry gets a reference ID, a row in **ebm_vendors**, and a reply **in the same thread** with their personal form link. Anything else is left for a person.
